table.name: card_printings
table.purpose: One row per Magic: The Gathering card printing (MTGJSON-style 'cards' table): each row is a specific physical/digital printing of a card in a set, with artist, frame, rarity, identifiers, rules text, and legality/format flags.

col_001.name: id
col_001.description: Auto-increment primary key for this printing row (1..56832).

col_002.name: artist
col_002.description: Illustrator name(s) of the card art (e.g. 'John Avon', 'Kev Walker').

col_003.name: original_name
col_003.description: Original printed card name, populated only for the few cards whose Oracle name differs from the original (values are old card names like 'El-Hajjaj', 'Dandan').

col_004.name: availability
col_004.description: Comma-separated platforms the printing is available on: arena, mtgo, paper, shandalar.

col_005.name: border_color
col_005.description: Card border color: black, white, silver (Un-sets), gold (championship), borderless.

col_006.name: identifier_mcm_or_similar
col_006.description: Numeric external card identifier (range 39000-241899, ~49% null) that maps one-to-one to rows in t02/t03; likely a store/catalog id such as CardMarket card id.

col_007.name: identifier_alt
col_007.description: Numeric external identifier (range 10000-241662, ~24% null) mapping one-to-one to t02/t03 rows; likely another store/catalog id (e.g. CardKingdom or TCGplayer id).

col_008.name: color_identity
col_008.description: Color identity (W/U/B/R/G codes, comma-separated). Populated even for lands (e.g. Plains = 'W'), hence lower null rate than colors.

col_009.name: color_indicator
col_009.description: Color indicator pips printed on the card face (99.7% null; only cards without a mana cost symbol, e.g. some lands/transform cards).

col_010.name: colors
col_010.description: Card colors (W/U/B/R/G codes, comma-separated); null for colorless cards and lands.

col_011.name: converted_mana_cost
col_011.description: Converted mana cost (0-14 typical; outlier 1000000 for special cards like 'Infinity').

col_012.name: duel_deck_side
col_012.description: Duel-deck side letter ('a' or 'b') for cards printed in duel decks.

col_013.name: edhrec_rank
col_013.description: EDHREC popularity rank (1-20900, ~8% null); joins many-to-one to t02/t03/t04. Could also be another ranking column, but rank-like distribution fits.

col_014.name: face_converted_mana_cost
col_014.description: Converted mana cost of a single face (split/flip cards only, hence 98% null; values 0-7).

col_015.name: face_name
col_015.description: Name of the front/back face for multi-face cards (e.g. 'Fire' // 'Ice', 'Nezumi Graverobber').

col_016.name: godzilla_series_name
col_016.description: Alternate 'Godzilla Series' name for the Ikoria Godzilla-monster printings (e.g. 'Babygodzilla, Ruin Reborn'); null for everything else in this snapshot.

col_017.name: flavor_text
col_017.description: Flavor text printed in the text box.

col_018.name: frame_effects
col_018.description: Comma-separated frame effect tags: legendary, extendedart, nyxtouched, showcase, miracle, snow, etc.

col_019.name: frame_version
col_019.description: Card frame version by year: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, or 'future'.

col_020.name: hand_modifier
col_020.description: Hand-size modifier for Vanguard cards (values -4..3, 99.8% null).

col_021.name: is_online_only
col_021.description: Boolean flag, true for only 12 rows; plausibly 'online only' printing, but the flag's exact meaning is not confirmed.

col_023.name: is_reprint
col_023.description: Whether the card is a reprint of an earlier printing (61% true).

col_024.name: has_non_foil
col_024.description: Whether a non-foil version exists (90.5% true).

col_025.name: is_story_spotlight
col_025.description: Story spotlight flag (288 true); plausible but not confirmed.

col_026.name: is_textless
col_026.description: Textless card flag (486 true); plausible but not confirmed.

col_027.name: is_promo
col_027.description: Promotional printing flag (4733 true, ~8%); plausible but not confirmed.

col_028.name: is_reserved
col_028.description: Reserved List flag (402 true); count is plausible for reserved-list printings but not confirmed.

col_030.name: is_paper
col_030.description: Whether available in paper (59% true, matches 'paper' in availability).

col_031.name: is_full_art
col_031.description: Full-art printing flag (1333 true); plausible but not confirmed.

col_032.name: is_mtgo
col_032.description: Whether available on MTGO (28% true, matches 'mtgo' in availability).

col_033.name: is_oversized
col_033.description: Oversized card flag (104 true); plausible but not confirmed.

col_036.name: keywords
col_036.description: Comma-separated keyword abilities (Flying, Trample, Equip, Cycling, etc.).

col_037.name: layout
col_037.description: Card layout: normal, transform, modal_dfc, split, adventure, leveler, scheme, augment, etc.

col_038.name: leadership_skills
col_038.description: Serialized dict of format legality as a commander: brawl/commander/oathbreaker booleans; only for legendary cards.

col_039.name: life_modifier
col_039.description: Starting life modifier for Vanguard cards (values -8..30, 99.8% null).

col_040.name: loyalty
col_040.description: Planeswalker starting loyalty (mostly integers 0-20, plus special values like '1d4+1' and '*').

col_041.name: mana_cost
col_041.description: Mana cost in MTG symbol notation, e.g. '{1}{W}', '{R/G}{R/G}'.

col_042.name: multiverse_id
col_042.description: Gatherer multiverse ID of the printing (range 1-535593, 14% null for digital-only printings).

col_043.name: mcm_id
col_043.description: CardMarket card id (range 1-330467, 31% null); joins to t03/t02.

col_044.name: card_kingdom_id
col_044.description: CardKingdom product id (range 6993-76889, 90% null); joins to t04.

col_045.name: scryfall_id
col_045.description: Unique UUID (version 5) of this printing, matching Scryfall's card id format; one per row.

col_046.name: external_id_046
col_046.description: Numeric external identifier (303-70586, 57% null) joining to t02/t03/t04; likely a store product id (e.g. TCGplayer product id), but exact source unconfirmed.

col_047.name: external_id_047
col_047.description: Numeric external identifier (9-87921, 43% null) joining to t02/t03/t04; likely another store/catalog id, exact source unconfirmed.

col_050.name: collector_number
col_050.description: Collector number within the set; includes non-numeric variants like 'br79', 'jf324'.

col_051.name: original_release_date
col_051.description: Original release date (YYYY/MM/DD), mostly for promos; some far-future dates (2049-2077) for special/unreleased items.

col_052.name: original_text
col_052.description: Rules text as originally printed (older wordings; 27% null).

col_053.name: original_type
col_053.description: Type line as originally printed (e.g. 'Summon - Fungus' on old cards).

col_054.name: other_face_ids
col_054.description: UUID(s) of the other face(s) of multi-face cards (97.6% null).

col_055.name: power
col_055.description: Creature power; includes special values like '*', '2+*', '∞'.

col_056.name: printings
col_056.description: Comma-separated list of set codes in which this card has been printed.

col_057.name: promo_types
col_057.description: Comma-separated promo categories: setpromo, prerelease, datestamped, boxtopper, boosterfun, mediainsert, etc.

col_058.name: purchase_uris
col_058.description: Serialized dict of vendor purchase URLs (cardKingdom, cardmarket, tcgplayer, etc.) via mtgjson.com redirect links.

col_059.name: rarity
col_059.description: Printing rarity: common, uncommon, rare, mythic.

col_060.name: scryfall_card_id
col_060.description: UUID grouping near-identical printings (56144 distinct, up to 5 rows share one); likely a Scryfall card/face id, but exact mapping unconfirmed.

col_061.name: scryfall_oracle_id
col_061.description: UUID shared by all printings of the same card (27250 distinct ≈ number of unique cards); likely Scryfall oracle id.

col_062.name: scryfall_illustration_id
col_062.description: UUID shared by printings with the same artwork (21769 distinct; e.g. all Plains printings with one art share it).

col_063.name: set_code
col_063.description: Set code of this printing (e.g. MB1, PRM, 2XM, 4BB); references t06.col_005.

col_064.name: side
col_064.description: Face letter for multi-face cards (a-e: split/aftermath/transform faces).

col_066.name: supertypes
col_066.description: Supertypes: Legendary, Basic, Snow, World, Ongoing.

col_067.name: external_id_067
col_067.description: Large numeric identifier (86-232634, 12% null) joining to t03/t02; likely a store/catalog id (e.g. TCGplayer product id), unconfirmed.

col_068.name: text
col_068.description: Current Oracle rules text, including reminder text.

col_069.name: toughness
col_069.description: Creature toughness; includes special values like '*', '*+1'.

col_070.name: type
col_070.description: Full type line (e.g. 'Creature — Kor Artificer', 'Basic Land — Plains').

col_071.name: types
col_071.description: Comma-separated main card types (Creature, Instant, Sorcery, Land, Artifact, Enchantment, Summon, Conspiracy).

col_072.name: uuid
col_072.description: Unique UUID of this printing; the key referenced by t02, t03 and t04.

col_073.name: related_cards
col_073.description: Comma-separated UUIDs of related cards (meld partners, token producers, etc.); 85% null.

col_074.name: watermark
col_074.description: Card watermark: faction names (mirran, phyrexian, golgari, dimir, izzet) or set names like 'set (FEM)'.

table.name: foreign_data
table.purpose: Localized (translated) card text entries — one row per card per language, holding the card's name, rules text, flavor text, and type line in that language. Content strongly matches Magic: The Gathering card printings (e.g. "Zyklop vom Blutfelsen", "Criatura Lendária", flying/legendary creature type lines).

col_001.name: translation_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique sequential integer identifier for each localized card-text row.

col_002.name: flavor_text
col_002.description: Flavor text of the card in the row's language; empty string when the card has none. Values are quotes/lore lines in many languages.

col_003.name: language
col_003.description: Language of this translation (e.g. Japanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Ancient Greek, Sanskrit, Latin, Hebrew, Portuguese (Brazil)).

col_004.name: card_reference_id
col_004.description: Integer identifier of the source card/face this translation belongs to (nullable, ~17% null). No accepted join was detected, so the exact target table/column is unresolved; it plausibly keys into another card table (e.g. t01/t06), but the evidence does not confirm which.

col_005.name: card_name
col_005.description: Localized name of the card (e.g. 'Pacifismo', '飛行', 'Solo Familiar').

col_006.name: rules_text
col_006.description: Localized rules/rules-text of the card, including keyword lines (e.g. 'Fliegend', 'Vol', '飞行'); empty when the card has no rules text.

col_007.name: type_line
col_007.description: Localized type line of the card (e.g. 'Kreatur — Zyklop', 'Criatura Lendária - Guerreiro Goblin', 'Spontanzauber' = instant); empty for cards without one.

col_008.name: card_uuid
col_008.description: UUID of the card (printing/face) this translation belongs to; references t01.col_072 (many-to-one), i.e. the parent card record.

table.name: card_format_legality
table.purpose: One row per (card, Magic: the Gathering format) pair, recording the card's legality status in that format. Formats like commander, legacy, vintage, modern, pauper, pioneer and statuses Legal/Banned/Restricted strongly indicate MTG legality data (e.g. Scryfall-style). Each card UUID appears ~15 times, matching the ~15 formats.

col_001.name: legality_id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key; sequential integer 1..427907 with no gaps, one per row.

col_002.name: format
col_002.description: Magic: the Gathering format name (commander, legacy, vintage, duel, modern, pauper, pioneer, premodern, penny, etc.); 15 distinct formats.

col_003.name: legality_status
col_003.description: Legality of the card in the given format: Legal, Banned, or Restricted.

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID (version 5) of the card, referencing t01.col_072 (the card table). Each card appears once per format (~15 rows).

table.name: rulings
table.purpose: Card rulings for a Magic: The Gathering-style card game: each row is one official rules clarification (ruling) attached to a specific card, identified by a UUID. The text values are verbatim MTG ruling wording (Cycling, Adventures, totem armor, planeswalk, etc.).

col_001.name: ruling_id
col_001.description: Primary key; a sequential integer ID (1..87769) uniquely identifying each ruling row. Referenced by columns in t01 and t06 (many-to-one), so other tables point at individual rulings.

col_002.name: released_at
col_002.description: Date the ruling was published/released, stored as a string. The range (2060-10-04 to 2077-02-05) is implausibly in the future for real MTG rulings, so the dates appear shifted/anonymized; the column is still clearly a per-ruling release date. Only 109 distinct dates, with heavy clustering on a few days, consistent with batch ruling releases.

col_003.name: ruling_text
col_003.description: The full text of the rules ruling/clarification, e.g. explanations of Cycling, Adventure spells, totem armor, unearth, planeswalking. Duplicated text (up to 283 occurrences) corresponds to generic rulings shared by many cards.

col_004.name: card_uuid
col_004.description: UUID (version-5 style) of the card the ruling applies to; references t01.col_072 (many-to-one), i.e. the card table. A card can have multiple rulings (up to ~27 per UUID).

table.name: localized_set_names
table.purpose: Per-language localized names of Magic: The Gathering sets/expansions; one row per (set, language) pair (121 sets x 10 languages = 1210 rows).

col_002.name: language
col_002.description: Language of the localized set name (e.g. Chinese Simplified, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian); 10 distinct languages, each appearing 121 times.

col_003.name: set_code
col_003.description: Magic: The Gathering set/expansion code (e.g. DDR, EVE, RTR = Return to Ravnica, M14, ARC); references the set lookup table t06.col_005.

col_004.name: localized_set_name
col_004.description: Name of the MTG set translated into the row's language (e.g. 'イーブンタイド' = Eventide in Japanese, 'Ritorno a Ravnica' = Return to Ravnica in Italian); null where no localized name exists (~19%).

table.name: sets
table.purpose: One row per Magic: The Gathering product/set (expansion, promo program, duel deck, etc.), in the style of Scryfall's set catalog: each row has a unique set code, set name, release date, set type, block info, parent set, and booster/size metadata. Referenced by card tables via the set code (col_005).

col_001.name: set_id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key for the set row (1-551, sequential).

col_002.name: base_set_size
col_002.description: Integer size attribute of the set, most plausibly the base set size (number of cards in the main set); 0 for small promo sets, up to 1694. The statistical joins to t01/t02/t03 are likely spurious (an id-range overlap), not real foreign keys. Could alternatively be total card count.

col_003.name: block
col_003.description: Name of the block the set belongs to (e.g. 'Theros', 'Kamigawa', 'Shadows over Innistrad'); null for non-block products like promos.

col_004.name: booster_contents
col_004.description: JSON description of booster pack contents (slot composition: basic/common/uncommon/rare/mythic counts, per product variant such as 'default' or 'arena'). Null for sets sold without boosters.

col_005.name: set_code
col_005.description: Unique set code (e.g. '10E', 'TSP', 'PGRN', 'MPR'); the natural key referenced by card rows in t01 and t05.

col_006.name: digital
col_006.description: Boolean flag: set exists only in digital form (MTGO/Arena). 167 of 551 sets flagged.

col_007.name: nonfoil_only
col_007.description: Boolean flag: set contains only non-foil cards (16 sets, mostly older/digital products).

col_008.name: foil_only
col_008.description: Boolean flag: set contains only foil cards (106 sets, mostly premium/promo products).

col_009.name: paper
col_009.description: Boolean flag, likely marking paper-only availability or a similar distribution channel; only 26 sets flagged, so the exact semantics are uncertain.

col_011.name: mtgo_code
col_011.description: Code used for the set on Magic Online (e.g. 'PMEI', 'PMPS', 'DCI'); 'DEFAULT' for sets without a distinct MTGO code. Overlaps with set codes because many share the same abbreviation.

col_012.name: parent_set_id
col_012.description: Numeric id of the parent set (for promo/special sets derived from a main expansion); null for ~64% of sets that have no parent. The one-to-one joins suggest it points at a set/card id in another table.

col_014.name: parent_set_name
col_014.description: Name of the parent set (e.g. 'Aether Revolt', 'Zendikar Expeditions' belongs to a named parent); null when the set has no parent.

col_015.name: parent_set_code
col_015.description: Set code of the parent set (e.g. '10E', 'TSP'); null when the set has no parent.

col_016.name: set_name
col_016.description: Full human-readable name of the set/product (e.g. 'Ultimate Masters', 'Magic Player Rewards 2001'); unique per row.

col_017.name: block_code
col_017.description: Code of the block the set belongs to (e.g. 'BFZ', 'ZNR'); null for non-block products. Some codes repeat across sets in the same block.

col_018.name: release_date
col_018.description: Release date of the set. The stored values (2049-2077) appear systematically shifted (roughly +30 years) from the real 1993-2021 MTG release dates, but the column is clearly the release date; far-future Jan-1 values mark undated promo products.

col_019.name: total_set_size
col_019.description: Printed/total size of the set (max 2778); the frequent value 62 and the many-to-one joins suggest a size or external group id, but the exact meaning is uncertain.

col_020.name: printed_size
col_020.description: Another set-size attribute closely mirroring col_002 (same top values, range 0-1694); plausibly the printed size or total set size as opposed to the base size in col_002. The joins to t01/t02/t03 are likely spurious id-range overlaps.
